outcome: Feasibility of mHealth-community health worker (CHW) home-based telemedicine intervention
Diagnostic accuracy of telemedicine for SSIs
cohort: 787 women who underwent a caesarean section at Kirehe District Hospital between September 2019 and March 2020
finding: An mHealth-CHW home-based telemedicine intervention for diagnosing SSIs in women post-cesarean section in rural Rwanda was feasible and had high patient acceptance, but telemedicine diagnosis had low sensitivity.
